title: The Great Kazoo Symphony Sabotage
crime_description: Every flutist's instrument case in the orchestra pit was replaced with a plastic metallic kazoo.

dossier.text: Security footage shows Bruno entering the Civic Auditorium at 9:45 PM wearing a black cloak.
Eyewitness reports a suspicious figure seen near the orchestra pit at 10:50 PM with a toolbox marked 'Property of Civic Auditorium Maintenance'.
Forensic analysis reveals a dropped screwdriver near the orchestra pit with Bruno's fingerprints on it.

truth_timeline.event: Bruno prepares tools and sneaks in.

lie_plan.cover_story: Bruno claims to be a maintenance worker assigned to replace old instrument cases with new ones.

weak_points.claim: Bruno claims he was in the Civic Auditorium library researching a book on harmonica history at 9:45 PM.
weak_points.planned_slip: Bruno will claim he was 'just browsing the shelves' when asked about the security footage.

weak_points.claim: Bruno claims the toolbox was left there by a maintenance worker who forgot to pick it up.
weak_points.planned_slip: Bruno will claim he 'must have borrowed it from someone' when asked about the toolbox.

weak_points.claim: Bruno claims the screwdriver was planted by a rival harmonica tuner as a prank.
weak_points.planned_slip: Bruno will claim he 'must have just seen it lying there' when asked about the screwdriver.

solution_contradictions: Bruno claimed he was in the library which directly conflicts with fact-1.
Bruno claimed the toolbox was left there by a maintenance worker which directly conflicts with fact-2.
